💀 Welcome to Jump To Steal SCP Monsters! 💀
🤝 Trade Update is live on new and VIP servers
💡- Get the Lucky Blocks to your base without getting caught to unlock new SCP Monsters!
💵- Use the money from the  SCP Monsters to upgrade your SCP and base!
⏰- Your SCP Monsters make money offline, so make sure to check on them everyday!

If you enjoy our game, Like it and join our group for surprises and more updates!☺️
